cr_data.provenance:
Sold by Doris Bry Gallery of 11 East Seventy-Third St., NY, NY 10021 to Mrs. Verne (Miriam Ruth) Minich in the late 1950s; In possession of Miriam Ruth until her death in 1976; Willed to Miriam's great-nephew, Jonathan Grau of Saginaw, Michigan. Moved to Ann Arbor, Michigan; Sold by De Graaf Forsyth Galleries for Mr. Grau to Wilma Steketee of Ann Arbor, Michigan, 1979; Consigned to Parke Bernet, NY, for American Painting Auction, Oct. 1979 
(Source: Honolulu Museum of Art, 2025)
